text: ok cool so can u run heightfields throuugh it for waves
resolution: Ran a heightfield through the water for waves. Each body now renders as ONE host heightfield mesh — a rippling top surface at surfaceY plus the heightfield's own perimeter skirt down to the basin floor — so it stays a translucent VOLUME you wade into but the surface animates; disc bodies round off via the skirt. Rides the same dynamic-heightfield path painted terrain uses, so the host reuses one slot per body and re-bakes on each version bump — animates with no geometry-slot leak. The travelling sine is baked into the height grid JS-side per tick (waterHeightGrid); a WaterBodies component owns a ~20fps clock so only the water subtree re-renders (WorldStatics never does), idle with no bodies. Editor/test only; compiled no-V8 still ships the static volume.
